local U=CS.UnityEngine
local V2=U.Vector2
local V3=U.Vector3
local Scope=require("official.core.runtime_scope")

local rules,outfits,weapons,fx

local root,canvas,contract,toggle,toggleLabel,confirmLabel,statusLabel

local font,nativeStyle

local ringSprite,ringTexture
local getRing
local detailLabel
local ink=U.Color(.18,.13,.086,1)
local cinnabar=U.Color(.61,.17,.12,1)

local native={}

local pending={}
local uiRefs={}
local external={menu=false,mounted=false,dead=false}
local openedPreview=false

local function toast(message)CS.DouyinUtility.Toast(message)end
local function rect(parent,name,w,h,x,y,anchor)
 local go=U.GameObject(name);go.transform:SetParent(parent,false)
 local rt=go:AddComponent(typeof(U.RectTransform));rt.anchorMin=anchor or V2(.5,.5);rt.anchorMax=rt.anchorMin
 rt.sizeDelta=V2(w,h);rt.anchoredPosition=V2(x,y);return go,rt
end
local function label(parent,name,value,size,w,h,x,y)
 local go=rect(parent,name,w,h,x,y);local t=go:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.Text))
 t.font=font;t.fontSize=size;t.text=value;t.color=U.Color.white;t.alignment=U.TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;t.raycastTarget=false
 return t
end
local function makeButton(parent,name,value,w,h,x,y,callback,anchor)
 local go=rect(parent,name,w,h,x,y,anchor);local im=go:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.Image))
 im.color=U.Color(1,1,1,.035)
 if nativeStyle then im.sprite=nativeStyle;im.type=U.UI.Image.Type.Sliced end
 local b=go:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.Button));b.targetGraphic=im
 local t=label(go.transform,"Label",value,26,w-10,h-4,0,0)
 b.onClick:AddListener(callback)
 return b,t
end
local function sourceFont()
 for _,name in ipairs({"CustomMain","CustomSub","Jump","HoldHands"})do
  local btn=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(CS.UIType[name])
  if btn then
   local t=btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(U.UI.Text),true)
   if t and t.font then font=t.font end
   if name=="CustomMain"and btn.image then nativeStyle=btn.image.sprite end
  end
 end
 local fonts=U.Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll(typeof(U.Font))
 for i=0,fonts.Length-1 do if fonts[i].name=="NotoSansSC-Medium"then font=fonts[i];break end end
 nativeStyle=nil -- CustomMain's default sprite is an unrelated platform placeholder.
 return font~=nil
end
local function buildUI()
 if root then return true end
 if not sourceFont()then return false end
 root=U.GameObject("DragonRPGControls");canvas=root:AddComponent(typeof(U.Canvas));canvas.renderMode=U.RenderMode.ScreenSpaceOverlay;canvas.sortingOrder=220
 local scaler=root:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.CanvasScaler));scaler.uiScaleMode=U.UI.CanvasScaler.ScaleMode.ScaleWithScreenSize;scaler.referenceResolution=V2(1920,1080);scaler.matchWidthOrHeight=1
 root:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.GraphicRaycaster))
 toggle,toggleLabel=makeButton(root.transform,"WeaponMenu","武器",92,92,-108,350,function()
  if context and context.mode=="combat"then SetMode("explore")else SetMode("combat")end
 end,V2(1,0))
 toggle.image.sprite=getRing();toggle.image.color=U.Color.white;toggleLabel.fontSize=23
 toggle.gameObject:SetActive(false)
 local drt
 backdrop,drt=rect(root.transform,"ContractBackdrop",0,0,0,0);drt.anchorMin=V2.zero;drt.anchorMax=V2.one;drt.offsetMin=V2.zero;drt.offsetMax=V2.zero
 backdrop:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.Image)).color=U.Color(0,0,0,.38);backdrop:SetActive(false)
 contract=rect(root.transform,"ClassContract",1200,800,0,0)
 local book=scope:GetGameObjectByPath("ContractBook")
 local renderer=book and book:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(U.Renderer),true)
 local texture=nil
 if renderer then for _,key in ipairs({"_BaseTex","_BaseMap","_MainTex"})do if renderer.sharedMaterial:HasProperty(key)then texture=texture or renderer.sharedMaterial:GetTexture(key)end end;book:SetActive(false)end
 local background=contract:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.RawImage));background.texture=texture;background.color=U.Color.white
 local title=label(contract.transform,"Title","守 夜 人 誓 约",39,470,70,-275,275);title.color=cinnabar
 local hint=label(contract.transform,"Hint","以此名立誓，守护龙的长梦。",22,460,55,-275,210);hint.color=ink
 local names={"melee","mage","ranged"}
 local descriptions={melee="剑誓 · 骑士\n\n身披铠甲，直面暗夜。\n以利刃驱散影灵，以护盾守住同伴。\n\n近战 · 破晓守护",mage="星誓 · 法师\n\n将散落的星火聚于掌心。\n用法杖唤醒魔力，让群星划破黑夜。\n\n远程 · 星火爆裂",ranged="风誓 · 游侠\n\n披林间的风，循月色而行。\n拉弓追逐游影，让箭羽回应誓言。\n\n远程 · 月羽连射"}
 detailLabel=label(contract.transform,"OathText","三条道路，同一个誓言。\n\n在左页选定职业，\n在此签下你的名字。",27,450,410,280,60);detailLabel.color=ink
 for i,kind in ipairs(names)do
  local c=rules.GetClasses()[kind]
  local button,text=makeButton(contract.transform,"Class_"..kind,({"剑誓  /  骑士","星誓  /  法师","风誓  /  游侠"})[i],420,88,-275,90-(i-1)*112,function()
   selection=kind
   for k,v in pairs(uiRefs)do v.image.color=k==kind and U.Color(.61,.17,.12,.13)or U.Color(1,1,1,0)end
   detailLabel.text=descriptions[kind];confirmLabel.text="立下誓约 · "..c.name
  end)
  button.image.color=U.Color(1,1,1,0);text.fontSize=29;text.color=ink;uiRefs[kind]=button
 end
 local confirm
 confirm,confirmLabel=makeButton(contract.transform,"SignContract","选择职业后签约",390,74,280,-240,function()
  if not selection then toast("请先选择职业");return end
  local ok,why=rules.SelectClass(profile,selection,external.inBattle)
  if not ok then toast(why);return end
  context.class=profile.class
  contract:SetActive(false);backdrop:SetActive(false);if previewButton then previewButton.gameObject:SetActive(true)end;context.menu=false;ready=true
  local callback=contractCallback;contractCallback=nil
  if callback then callback(profile.class)else actor:Immobilize(false)end
  log:info("class contracted",profile.class)
 end)
 confirm.image.color=U.Color(.61,.17,.12,.14);confirmLabel.color=cinnabar
 statusLabel=label(contract.transform,"Status","日后可在萤光古树下，重新立誓。",19,460,60,-275,-280);statusLabel.color=U.Color(.42,.34,.25,1)
 contract:SetActive(false)
 if PreviewMode then local btn,txt=makeButton(root.transform,"PreviewClassSwitch","誓约",86,86,100,-205,function()OpenContract(true,nil)end,V2(0,1));btn.image.sprite=getRing();btn.image.color=U.Color.white;txt.fontSize=22;previewButton=btn end
 return true
end
getRing=function()
 if ringSprite then return ringSprite end
 ringTexture=U.Texture2D(96,96,U.TextureFormat.RGBA32,false)
 local pixels=CS.System.Array.CreateInstance(typeof(U.Color),96*96)
 for y=0,95 do for x=0,95 do
  local d=math.sqrt((x-47.5)^2+(y-47.5)^2)
  pixels[y*96+x]=d>46 and U.Color.clear or(d>42 and U.Color(1,1,1,.9)or U.Color(1,1,1,.035))
 end end
 ringTexture:SetPixels(pixels);ringTexture:Apply()
 ringSprite=U.Sprite.Create(ringTexture,U.Rect(0,0,96,96),V2(.5,.5),100)
 return ringSprite
end
local function clearSlots()
 held=false;attackPressed=false;skillPressed=false;pending={}
 for _,v in ipairs(native)do
  if v.trigger then v.trigger.triggers:Clear()end
  if v.button then
   v.button.gameObject:SetActive(false)
   if v.old then
    v.button.image.sprite=v.old.sprite;v.button.image.color=v.old.color
    local rt=v.button.transform;rt.localPosition=v.old.position;rt.sizeDelta=v.old.size
    if v.label then v.label.text=v.old.text;v.label.color=v.old.color;v.label.font=v.old.font;v.label.fontSize=v.old.fontSize;v.label.alignment=v.old.alignment;v.label.rectTransform.localPosition=v.old.labelPosition;v.label.rectTransform.sizeDelta=v.old.labelSize end
   end
  end
 end
 native={}
 for _,v in ipairs(hidden)do
  if v.group then
   v.group.alpha=v.alpha;v.group.blocksRaycasts=v.ray;v.group.interactable=v.interact
   if v.added then U.Object.Destroy(v.group)end
  end
 end
 hidden={}
end
local function hideExplore()
 for _,name in ipairs({"Jump","HoldHands","StopHoldHands"})do
  local btn=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(CS.HandType.Right,CS.UIType[name])
  if btn then
   local group=btn.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(U.CanvasGroup));local added=group==nil
   if not group then group=btn.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(U.CanvasGroup))end
   hidden[#hidden+1]={group=group,added=added,alpha=group.alpha,ray=group.blocksRaycasts,interact=group.interactable}
   group.alpha=0;group.blocksRaycasts=false;group.interactable=false
  end
 end
end
local function bindSlot(kind,text,down,up,targetType)
 local btn=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(kind);if not btn then return nil end
 local trigger=btn.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(U.EventSystems.EventTrigger))
 if not trigger then trigger=btn.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(U.EventSystems.EventTrigger))end
 trigger.triggers:Clear()
 for _,event in ipairs({{U.EventSystems.EventTriggerType.PointerDown,down},{U.EventSystems.EventTriggerType.PointerUp,up},{U.EventSystems.EventTriggerType.PointerExit,up}})do
  local e=U.EventSystems.EventTrigger.Entry();e.eventID=event[1];e.callback:AddListener(event[2]);trigger.triggers:Add(e)
 end
 local t=btn:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(U.UI.Text),true)
 local rt=btn.transform
 local old={sprite=btn.image.sprite,color=btn.image.color,position=rt.localPosition,size=rt.sizeDelta}
 if t then
  old.text=t.text;old.color=t.color;old.font=t.font;old.fontSize=t.fontSize;old.alignment=t.alignment;old.labelPosition=t.rectTransform.localPosition;old.labelSize=t.rectTransform.sizeDelta
  t.gameObject:SetActive(true);t.color=U.Color.white;t.text=text;t.font=font;t.fontSize=25;t.alignment=U.TextAnchor.MiddleCenter;t.rectTransform.localPosition=V3.zero;t.rectTransform.sizeDelta=V2(120,65)
 end
 btn.image.sprite=getRing();btn.image.color=U.Color.white
 local target=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(CS.HandType.Right,targetType)
 if target then rt.position=target.transform.position;rt.sizeDelta=target.transform.sizeDelta end
 btn.gameObject:SetActive(true)
 local entry={button=btn,trigger=trigger,label=t,old=old};native[#native+1]=entry;return entry
end
function SetMode(mode)
 if not context or not actor then return false end
 if mode~="combat"and mode~="explore"then return false end
 if mode==context.mode then return true end
 if mode=="combat"then
  if not profile.class then OpenContract(false,nil);return false end
  if not ready or context.menu or external.menu or external.mounted or actor:IsSitting()or actor:IsFlying()or external.dead then return false end
  if not weapons.Equip(actor,profile.class)then toast("武器正在准备，请稍候");return false end
  -- Only take the native global slots when they are free.
  for _,kind in ipairs({CS.UIType.CustomMain,CS.UIType.CustomSub})do
   local b=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(kind)
   if not b or b.gameObject.activeSelf then weapons.Unequip(actor);toast("请先结束当前操作");return false end
  end
  bindSlot(CS.UIType.CustomMain,"普攻",function()held=true;attackPressed=true end,function()held=false end,CS.UIType.Jump)
  bindSlot(CS.UIType.CustomSub,"技能",function()skillPressed=true end,function()end,CS.UIType.HoldHands)
  hideExplore();context.mode="combat";toggleLabel.text="收起"
 else
  clearSlots();context.mode="explore";weapons.Unequip(actor);fx.Clear();toggleLabel.text="武器"
 end
 return true
end
function OpenContract(change,callback)
 if not rules or not actor or not buildUI()then return false end
 if external.inBattle then toast("战斗结束后才能重新签约");return false end
 SetMode("explore");context.menu=true;ready=false;respec=change;selection=nil;contractCallback=callback
 confirmLabel.text="选择职业后签约";contract:SetActive(true);backdrop:SetActive(true);if previewButton then previewButton.gameObject:SetActive(false)end;actor:Immobilize(true)
 return true
end
function SetContext(value)
 for k,v in pairs(value or {})do external[k]=v end
 if external.menu or external.mounted or external.dead then SetMode("explore")end
end
function SetExplorationReady(value)ready=value==true end
function SetProfile(value)
 if not value or value.schema~=1 then return false end
 profile=value;if context then context.class=value.class end;return true
end
function GetProfile()return profile end
function GetStatus()
 return {mode=context and context.mode,class=profile and profile.class,ready=ready,sequence=context and context.sequence,contract=contract and contract.activeSelf,
  nativeSlots=#native,pending=#pending,held=held,outfit=actor and outfits and outfits.GetOutfitStatus(actor),
  weapon=actor and weapons and weapons.GetRigStatus(actor)}
end
local function act(kind)
 local action=rules.TryAction(context,kind,U.Time.time);if not action then return end
 local d=actor.rotation*V3.forward;local p=actor.position;local target=V3(p.x+d.x*action.range,p.y+.8,p.z+d.z*action.range)
 if weapons.Attack(actor,profile.class,kind=="skill"and"skill1"or"attack",target)then
  action.origin=V3(p.x,p.y+.8,p.z);action.direction=d;pending[#pending+1]=action
 end
end
function FixedUpdate()
 if not context or not actor or context.mode~="combat"then return end
 context.mounted=external.mounted or actor:IsSitting();context.flying=actor:IsFlying();context.dead=external.dead;context.menu=external.menu or(contract and contract.activeSelf)
 if not rules.CanUse(context)then SetMode("explore");return end
 if skillPressed then skillPressed=false;act("skill")elseif held or attackPressed then attackPressed=false;act("attack")end
end
function Update()
 if not scope then return end
 if not rules then rules=scope:GetScript("dragon_rules.lua");outfits=scope:GetScript("dragon_outfits.lua");weapons=scope:GetScript("dragon_weapons.lua");fx=scope:GetScript("dragon_fx.lua")end
 if not rules or not outfits or not weapons or not fx then rules=nil;return end
 actor=CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor();if not actor then return end
 if not profile then profile=rules.NewProfile();context={mode="explore",class=nil}end
 if not buildUI()then return end
 if PreviewMode and not openedPreview then openedPreview=OpenContract(false,nil)end
 if profile.class then outfits.Equip(actor,profile.class)end
 local available=ready and not context.menu and not external.menu and not external.mounted and not external.dead and not actor:IsSitting()and not actor:IsFlying()
 toggle.gameObject:SetActive(available)
 local safe=U.Screen.safeArea;local scale=1080/U.Screen.height
 local rt=toggle.transform
 rt.anchoredPosition=V2(-(U.Screen.width-safe.xMax)*scale-108,(safe.yMin)*scale+(context.mode=="combat"and 550 or 450))
 if not available and context.mode=="combat"then SetMode("explore")end
 if context.mode=="combat"then
  for _,v in ipairs(hidden)do v.group.alpha=0;v.group.blocksRaycasts=false end
  local left=math.max(0,(context.skillUntil or 0)-U.Time.time)
  if native[2]and native[2].label then native[2].label.text=left>0 and string.format("%.1f",left)or "技能" end
 end
 for i=#pending,1,-1 do local a=pending[i]
  if U.Time.time>=a.hitAt then fx.Play(a.class,a.kind,a.origin,a.direction);table.remove(pending,i)end
 end
end
function OnApplicationFocus(focused)if not focused then held=false;attackPressed=false;skillPressed=false end end
function OnDisable()
 clearSlots();if actor and weapons then weapons.Unequip(actor)end
 if actor and contract and contract.activeSelf then actor:Immobilize(false)end
 if root then root:SetActive(false)end
end
function OnDestroy()
 OnDisable();if actor and outfits then outfits.Unequip(actor)end
 if root then U.Object.Destroy(root);root=nil end
 if ringSprite then U.Object.Destroy(ringSprite);U.Object.Destroy(ringTexture);ringSprite=nil;ringTexture=nil end
end

local function rotateVector(rotation, value)

  local sourcePath = CLASS_SOURCE[className]
  if sourcePath == nil or resourceRootTransform == nil then return false end

  local source=runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(sourcePath)
  local signature=completeVisual(source,className)
  if not signature then return false end

  local clone=entry.pendingClone
  if clone and (not isAlive(clone) or entry.pendingClass~=className or entry.pendingSignature~=signature)then
    pcall(function()Spawn.destroy(clone)end);clone=nil;entry.pendingClone=nil
  end
  if not clone then
    local ok,created=pcall(function()return Spawn.spawn(self,sourcePath,{networked=false})end)
    if not ok or not created then
      logger:warnOnce("spawn-failed-"..className,"outfit spawn failed",tostring(created));return false
    end
    clone=created;clone:SetActive(false)
    entry.pendingClone=clone;entry.pendingClass=className;entry.pendingSignature=signature
  end
  if not completeVisual(clone,className)then return false end
  entry.pendingClone=nil;entry.pendingClass=nil;entry.pendingSignature=nil
  entry.sourceSignature=signature
  clone:SetActive(false)
  clone.transform:SetParent(resourceRootTransform, true)
  clone.transform.localPosition = Vector3(0, 0, 0)
  clone.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity
  clone.transform.localScale = Vector3(1, 1, 1)
  disableCollisions(clone)

  entry.clone = clone
  entry.className = className
  entry.baseScale = computeBaseScale(
    bonePosition(entry.actor, HumanBodyBones.Hips),
    bonePosition(entry.actor, HumanBodyBones.Head)
  )
  entry.actorScale = actorScaleOf(entry.actor)
  tailor(entry)
  collectParts(entry)
  return true
end

local function ensureClone(entry, className)
  if entry.clone ~= nil and entry.className == className then
    if Time.time<(entry.nextHealthCheck or 0) then return end
    entry.nextHealthCheck=Time.time+.5
    local source=runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(CLASS_SOURCE[className])
    local signature=completeVisual(source,className)
    if completeVisual(entry.clone,className) and (not signature or signature==entry.sourceSignature) then return end
  end
  if entry.clone ~= nil then clearClone(entry) end
  spawnClone(entry, className)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 骨架对齐
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 克隆创建时缓存基准缩放；之后只叠乘 GlobalScale，仅在 actor.scale 明显变化时重算。
local function worldScaleFor(entry, hips, head)
  local currentActorScale = actorScaleOf(entry.actor)
  if currentActorScale ~= nil then
    if entry.actorScale == nil then
      entry.actorScale = currentActorScale
    elseif math.abs(currentActorScale - entry.actorScale) > 0.05 then
      entry.actorScale = currentActorScale
      entry.baseScale = computeBaseScale(hips, head) or entry.baseScale
    end
  end
  -- Recompute when avatar proportions settle; actor.scale alone does not change
  -- when a placeholder is replaced by the user's final appearance.
  entry.baseScale=computeBaseScale(hips,head) or entry.baseScale
  return clamp((entry.baseScale or 1) * globalScaleValue(), MIN_SCALE, MAX_SCALE)
end

local function applyRootScale(entry, worldScale)
  if entry.clone == nil or resourceRootTransform == nil then return end
  local parentScale = resourceRootTransform.lossyScale
  local function factor(value)
    if math.abs(value) < 0.0001 then return 1 end
    return value
  end
  entry.clone.transform.localScale = Vector3(
    worldScale / factor(parentScale.x),
    worldScale / factor(parentScale.y),
    worldScale / factor(parentScale.z)
  )
end

local function limbRotation(rootPosition, endPosition, outward, fallbackUp)
  local zAxis = safeUnit(subtract(endPosition, rootPosition), fallbackUp)
  local yAxis = safeUnit(subtractUnit(outward, zAxis), fallbackUp)
  return Quaternion.LookRotation(zAxis, yAxis)
end

local function updateEntry(entry, deltaTime)
  if entry.clone == nil or entry.className == "" then return end

  if entry.visible==false or not isActorRenderable(entry) then
    if entry.clone.activeSelf then entry.clone:SetActive(false) end
    return
  end
  local actor = entry.actor
  local hips = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  local chest = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.Chest)
  local head = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.Head)
  local leftUpper = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.LeftUpperArm)
  local rightUpper = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.RightUpperArm)
  local leftLower = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.LeftLowerArm)
  local rightLower = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.RightLowerArm)
  local leftHand = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.LeftHand)
  local rightHand = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.RightHand)

  if hips==nil or chest==nil or head==nil or leftUpper==nil or rightUpper==nil or leftLower==nil or rightLower==nil or leftHand==nil or rightHand==nil then
    entry.clone:SetActive(false);entry.posed=false;return
  end
  local distance=Vector3.Distance(hips,head)
  if distance~=distance or distance<.02 or distance>4 then
    entry.clone:SetActive(false);entry.posed=false;return
  end

  local torsoUp = safeUnit(subtract(chest, hips), Vector3(0, 1, 0))

  -- 朝向优先取 actor.rotation 的前向，并投影到躯干 up 轴；臂展只作兜底。
  local forward = nil
  local actorRotation = actorRotationOf(actor)
  if actorRotation ~= nil then
    local ok, rawForward = pcall(function()
      return rotateVector(actorRotation, Vector3(0, 0, 1))
    end)
    if ok and rawForward ~= nil then
      local projected = subtract(rawForward, scaleVector(torsoUp, dot(rawForward, torsoUp)))
      if lengthOf(projected) > 0.0001 then
        forward = safeUnit(projected, Vector3(0, 0, 1))
      end
    end
  end
  if forward == nil and leftUpper ~= nil and rightUpper ~= nil then
    local span = subtract(rightUpper, leftUpper)
    if lengthOf(span) > 0.0001 then
      forward = safeUnit(cross(safeUnit(span, Vector3(1, 0, 0)), torsoUp), Vector3(0, 0, 1))
    end
  end
  if forward == nil then
    forward = safeUnit(cross(Vector3(1, 0, 0), torsoUp), Vector3(0, 0, 1))
  end
  local lateral = safeUnit(cross(torsoUp, forward), Vector3(1, 0, 0))
  local torsoRotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(forward, torsoUp)

  local worldScale = worldScaleFor(entry, hips, head)
  applyRootScale(entry, worldScale)

  local velocity = actor.velocity
  local velocityRight = 0
  local velocityForward = 0
  if velocity ~= nil then
    velocityRight = dot(velocity, lateral)
    velocityForward = dot(velocity, forward)
  end

  for _, part in ipairs(entry.parts) do
    local spec = part.spec
    local transform = part.transform
    if spec.kind == "torso" then
      if spec.name == "Chest" then
        transform.position = chest
      else
        transform.position = hips
      end
      transform.rotation = torsoRotation
    elseif spec.kind == "upperArm" then
      -- 源模型 +X 部件（L）跟随角色右侧骨骼，-X 部件（R）跟随左侧。
      local rootBone = spec.side == "L" and rightUpper or leftUpper
      local endBone = spec.side == "L" and rightLower or leftLower
      if endBone ~= nil and rootBone ~= nil then
        local outward = spec.side == "L" and lateral or negate(lateral)
        local anchor = rootBone
        if spec.shift ~= nil then
          anchor = lerpVector(rootBone, endBone, spec.shift)
        end
        transform.position = anchor
        transform.rotation = limbRotation(rootBone, endBone, outward, torsoUp)
      end
    elseif spec.kind == "forearm" then
      local elbow = spec.side == "L" and rightLower or leftLower
      local hand = spec.side == "L" and rightHand or leftHand
      if elbow ~= nil then
        local outward = spec.side == "L" and lateral or negate(lateral)
        local endPosition = hand
        if endPosition == nil then
          local rootBone = spec.side == "L" and rightUpper or leftUpper
          endPosition = Vector3(
            elbow.x + (elbow.x - rootBone.x),
            elbow.y + (elbow.y - rootBone.y),
            elbow.z + (elbow.z - rootBone.z)
          )
        end
        transform.position = lerpVector(elbow, endPosition, 0.45)
        transform.rotation = limbRotation(elbow, endPosition, outward, torsoUp)
      end
    elseif spec.kind == "hem" or spec.kind == "torsoOffset" then
      local reference = hips
      if spec.parent == "chest" then reference = chest elseif spec.parent == "head"then reference=head end
      local offset = spec.offset
      local offsetX = offset[1] * worldScale
      local offsetY = offset[2] * worldScale
      local offsetZ = offset[3] * worldScale
      transform.position = Vector3(
        reference.x + lateral.x * offsetX + torsoUp.x * offsetY + forward.x * offsetZ,
        reference.y + lateral.y * offsetX + torsoUp.y * offsetY + forward.y * offsetZ,
        reference.z + lateral.z * offsetX + torsoUp.z * offsetY + forward.z * offsetZ
      )

      if spec.kind == "hem" then
        local targetPitch = spec.basePitch + clamp(velocityForward * 9, -spec.forwardLimit, spec.backLimit)
        local targetRoll = clamp(-velocityRight * 7, -spec.rollLimit, spec.rollLimit)
        local idle = math.sin(elapsed * 1.6 + spec.phase) * 0.9
        local smoothing = 1 - math.exp(-deltaTime * 7)
        part.pitch = part.pitch + (targetPitch + idle - part.pitch) * smoothing
        part.roll = part.roll + (targetRoll - part.roll) * smoothing
        transform.rotation = torsoRotation * Quaternion.Euler(part.pitch, 0, part.roll)
      else
        transform.rotation = torsoRotation
      end
    end
  end
  entry.posed=true
  if not entry.clone.activeSelf then entry.clone:SetActive(true)end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Actor 同步
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function syncActor(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local gameObject = actorGameObject(actor)
  if not isAlive(gameObject) then return end
  local actorId = actorIdOf(actor)
  if actorId == nil then return end
  local entry = actors[actorId]
  if entry == nil then
    entry = {
      actor = actor,
      actorID = actorId,
      className = "",
      clone = nil,
      parts = {},
      mainRenderer = nil,
      visible = true,
    }
    actors[actorId] = entry
  end

  entry.actor = actor
  local className, visible = readState(actor)
  entry.visible = visible
  if entry.mainRenderer == nil then
    entry.mainRenderer = findMainRenderer(gameObject)
  end

  if className == "" then
    clearClone(entry)
    return
  end

  ensureClone(entry, className)
  if not visible or not isActorRenderable(entry) then
    if entry.clone ~= nil and entry.clone.activeSelf then
      entry.clone:SetActive(false)
    end
    return
  end

  -- LateUpdate enables the clone only after a complete valid bone pose.
end

local function refreshActors()
  local ok, list = pcall(function()
    return CS.DouyinActorService.GetActors()
  end)
  if not ok or list == nil then return end

  local seen = {}
  for index = 0, list.Length - 1 do
    local actor = list[index]
    local gameObject = actorGameObject(actor)
    local actorId = actorIdOf(actor)
    if actor ~= nil and isAlive(gameObject) and actorId ~= nil then
      seen[actorId] = true
      syncActor(actor)
    end
  end

  local stale = {}
  for actorId, entry in pairs(actors) do
    if seen[actorId] ~= true then
      table.insert(stale, actorId)
    end
    if entry.actor == nil or not isAlive(actorGameObject(entry.actor)) then
      table.insert(stale, actorId)
    end
  end
  for _, actorId in ipairs(stale) do
    local entry = actors[actorId]
    if entry ~= nil then
      clearClone(entry)
      actors[actorId] = nil
    end
  end
end

local function clearAll()
  for actorId, entry in pairs(actors) do
    clearClone(entry)
  end
  actors = {}
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runtime Host 接入
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function handleRefresh(eventName, payload)
  if eventName ~= REFRESH_EVENT then return false end
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then return false end

  local actorId = tonumber(payload.actorID)
  if actorId == nil then
    refreshTimer = REFRESH_INTERVAL
    return true
  end

  local ok, actor = pcall(function()
    return CS.DouyinActorService.GetActorById(actorId)
  end)
  if not ok or actor == nil then return true end

  syncActor(actor)
  return true
end

local function registerWithHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil or resourceEntry ~= nil then return end
  local host = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil or type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "outfit refresh events disabled")
    return
  end
  resourceEntry = host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    events = { REFRESH_EVENT },
    handler = handleRefresh,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })
end

local function unregisterFromHost()
  if resourceEntry == nil or runtimeScope == nil then return end
  local host = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
    host.UnregisterResource(resourceEntry)
  end
  resourceEntry = nil
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 生命周期
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local nextInitAttempt=-1
local outfitStatus="waiting resources"
function Start()
 if started or Time.time<nextInitAttempt then return end
 nextInitAttempt=Time.time+.5
 -- RuntimeScope is fixed by the saved binding; retry only model payload readiness.
 resourceRoot=runtimeScope and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot()or nil
 resourceRootTransform=resourceRoot and resourceRoot.transform or nil
 if not resourceRoot then outfitStatus="scope unavailable";return end
 local sourceSets=runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(SOURCE_SETS_PATH)
 if not sourceSets then outfitStatus="source sets missing";return end
 for className,path in pairs(CLASS_SOURCE)do
  if not runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(path)then outfitStatus="source missing: "..className;return end
 end
 disableCollidersOn(resourceRoot)
 sourceSets.localPosition=PROTOTYPE_PARK
 disableCollidersOn(sourceSets.gameObject)
 started=true;outfitStatus="resources ready"
 registerWithHost()
 refreshActors()
end

function OnEnable()
  if started then registerWithHost() end
end

function OnDisable()
  unregisterFromHost()
  clearAll()
end

function OnDestroy()
  unregisterFromHost()
  clearAll()
end

function OnActorSpawned(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  syncActor(actor)
end

function OnActorDespawned(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local actorId = actorIdOf(actor)
  if actorId == nil then return end
  local entry = actors[actorId]
  if entry ~= nil then
    clearClone(entry)
    actors[actorId] = nil
  end
end

function Update()
  if not started then Start()end
  if not started then return end
  if not resourceEntry then registerWithHost()end
  refreshTimer = refreshTimer + Time.deltaTime
  if refreshTimer >= REFRESH_INTERVAL then
    refreshTimer = 0
    refreshActors()
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then return end
  local deltaTime = Time.deltaTime
  elapsed = elapsed + deltaTime

  for _, entry in pairs(actors) do
    updateEntry(entry, deltaTime)
  end
end
-- Driven by the existing replicated combat snapshot; no second network state.
function Equip(actor, className)
 if not started then Start()end
 if not started then return false end
 local id=actorIdOf(actor)
 if id==nil or CLASS_SOURCE[className]==nil then return false end
 local state=gameStates[id]
 if not state or state.actor~=actor or state.className~=className then
  gameStates[id]={actor=actor,className=className,visible=state==nil or state.visible}
  syncActor(actor)
 end
 local entry=actors[id]
 return entry~=nil and isAlive(entry.clone) and entry.sourceSignature~=nil
end
function SetVisible(actor, visible)
 local id=actorIdOf(actor);local state=id and gameStates[id]
 if not state then return false end
 if state.visible~=(visible==true)then state.visible=visible==true;syncActor(actor)end
 return true
end
function Unequip(actor)
 local id=actorIdOf(actor);if id==nil then return end
 gameStates[id]=nil
 local entry=actors[id]
 if entry then clearClone(entry);actors[id]=nil end
end

function GetOutfitStatus(actor)
 local entry=actors[actorIdOf(actor)]
 if not entry or not entry.clone then return outfitStatus.."; clone pending"end
 return entry.clone.activeInHierarchy and "visible"or "hidden"
end

function ResourcesReady()
 if not started then Start()end
 if not started then return false,outfitStatus end
 for className,path in pairs(CLASS_SOURCE)do
  if not completeVisual(runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(path),className)then return false,"outfit mesh pending: "..className end
 end
 return true,"ready"
end
function IsReady(actor,className)
 local id=actorIdOf(actor);local entry=id and actors[id]
 if not entry or entry.className~=className or not isAlive(entry.clone)then return false end
 return entry.posed==true and entry.clone.activeInHierarchy and completeVisual(entry.clone,className)~=nil
end

-- Verify actual geometry, not merely the presence of a GameObject.
local function visualSignature(go)
 if go==nil then return nil end
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  local E=CS.UnityEngine
  local rs=go:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(E.Renderer),true)
  local keys={};local count=0
  for i=0,rs.Length-1 do
   local r=rs[i];local skin=r:GetComponent(typeof(E.SkinnedMeshRenderer))
   local filter=r:GetComponent(typeof(E.MeshFilter))
   if skin~=nil or filter~=nil then
    local mesh=skin~=nil and skin.sharedMesh or filter.sharedMesh
    if mesh==nil or mesh.vertexCount<=0 then return nil end
    local mats=r.sharedMaterials
    if mats==nil or mats.Length==0 then return nil end
    for j=0,mats.Length-1 do if mats[j]==nil then return nil end end
    local key=tostring(mesh:GetInstanceID())
    if skin~=nil then
     local bones=skin.bones
     if bones==nil or bones.Length==0 or skin.rootBone==nil then return nil end
     for j=0,bones.Length-1 do if bones[j]==nil then return nil end end
     key=key..":"..tostring(bones.Length)..":"..tostring(skin.rootBone:GetInstanceID())
    end
    count=count+1;keys[count]=key
   end
  end
  if count==0 then return nil end
  return table.concat(keys,"|")
 end)
 return ok and result or nil
end

-- 向量工具全部按分量重建，避免依赖运行时不一定暴露的运算符重载。
local function vAdd(a, b)
  return Vector3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z)
end

local function vSub(a, b)
  return Vector3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z)
end

local function vScale(a, scale)
  return Vector3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale)
end

local function vDot(a, b)
  return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
end

local function vCross(a, b)
  return Vector3(
    a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
    a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
    a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x
  )
end

local function vLength(a)
  return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y + a.z * a.z)
end

local function vNormalize(a)
  local length = vLength(a)
  if length < 1e-6 then return Vector3(0, 0, 1) end
  return Vector3(a.x / length, a.y / length, a.z / length)
end

local function vLerp(a, b, t)
  return Vector3(
    a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t,
    a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t,
    a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t
  )
end

-- 时间轴使用人物局部轴；绕人物 up 旋转 yaw 后再转世界向量。
local function rotateLocalYaw(value, yaw)
  local cosine = math.cos(yaw)
  local sine = math.sin(yaw)
  return {
    value[1] * cosine + value[3] * sine,
    value[2],
    -value[1] * sine + value[3] * cosine,
  }
end

local function clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
  if value < minimum then return minimum end
  if value > maximum then return maximum end
  return value
end

local function liveObject(go)
  if go==nil then return false end
  local ok,t=pcall(function()return go.transform end)
  return ok and t~=nil
end
local function isActorAlive(actor)
  if actor == nil then return false end
  local ok, gameObject = pcall(function() return actor.gameObject end)
  return ok and gameObject ~= nil
end

local function actorRoot(actor)
  if not isActorAlive(actor) then return nil end
  return actor.gameObject.transform
end

local function getCalibration(className)
  if className == "melee" then
    return {
      shift = SwordGripShift,
      pitch = SwordGripPitch,
      yaw = SwordGripYaw,
      roll = SwordGripRoll,
    }
  elseif className == "ranged" then
    return {
      shift = CrossbowGripShift,
      pitch = CrossbowGripPitch,
      yaw = CrossbowGripYaw,
      roll = CrossbowGripRoll,
    }
  end
  return {
    shift = StaffGripShift,
    pitch = StaffGripPitch,
    yaw = StaffGripYaw,
    roll = StaffGripRoll,
  }
end

local function buildRig(actor, className)
  if not isActorAlive(actor) then return nil end

  local animator = actor.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(Animator))
  if animator == nil then return nil end

  local left=className=="ranged"
  local ok, bones = pcall(function()
    return {
      upper = animator:GetBoneTransform(left and HumanBodyBones.LeftUpperArm or HumanBodyBones.RightUpperArm),
      lower = animator:GetBoneTransform(left and HumanBodyBones.LeftLowerArm or HumanBodyBones.RightLowerArm),
      hand = animator:GetBoneTransform(left and HumanBodyBones.LeftHand or HumanBodyBones.RightHand),
      spine = animator:GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.Spine),
    }
  end)
  if not ok then return nil end
  if bones.upper == nil or bones.lower == nil or bones.hand == nil then return nil end

  local upperLength = vLength(vSub(bones.lower.position, bones.upper.position))
  local lowerLength = vLength(vSub(bones.hand.position, bones.lower.position))
  if upperLength < 1e-4 or lowerLength < 1e-4 then return nil end

  bones.upperLength = upperLength
  bones.lowerLength = lowerLength
  bones.reach = upperLength + lowerLength
  if left then
    local upper=animator:GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.RightUpperArm)
    local lower=animator:GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.RightLowerArm)
    local hand=animator:GetBoneTransform(HumanBodyBones.RightHand)
    if upper and lower and hand then
      local a=vLength(vSub(lower.position,upper.position));local b=vLength(vSub(hand.position,lower.position))
      bones.draw={upper=upper,lower=lower,hand=hand,upperLength=a,lowerLength=b,reach=a+b}
    end
  end
  return bones
end

local function ensureTimelineScript()
  if timelineScript ~= nil then return timelineScript end
  if runtimeScope == nil then return nil end
  timelineScript = runtimeScope:GetScript(TIMELINE_SCRIPT_ID)
  return timelineScript
end

local function enableCopyRenderers(gameObject)
  if gameObject == nil then return end
  local renderers = gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(Renderer), true)
  if renderers == nil then return end
  for index = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
    local renderer = renderers[index]
    if renderer ~= nil then renderer.enabled = true end
  end
end

local function hideSourceWeapons()
  if ShowSourceWeapons then return end
  for _, definition in pairs(WEAPON_DEFS) do
    if definition.sourceGo ~= nil then
      local renderers = definition.sourceGo:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(Renderer), true)
      if renderers ~= nil then
        for index = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
          local renderer = renderers[index]
          if renderer ~= nil then renderer.enabled = false end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

local function measureWeapon(weapon)
 local lo={math.huge,math.huge,math.huge};local hi={-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge}
 local meshes=weapon:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.MeshFilter),true)
 for i=0,meshes.Length-1 do
  local m=meshes[i]
  if m.sharedMesh then
   local b=m.sharedMesh.bounds;local mn=b.min;local mx=b.max
   for x=0,1 do for y=0,1 do for z=0,1 do
    local w=m.transform:TransformPoint(Vector3(x==0 and mn.x or mx.x,y==0 and mn.y or mx.y,z==0 and mn.z or mx.z))
    local q=weapon.transform:InverseTransformPoint(w);local v={q.x,q.y,q.z}
    for k=1,3 do lo[k]=math.min(lo[k],v[k]);hi[k]=math.max(hi[k],v[k])end
   end end end
  end
 end
 local extent=math.max(hi[1]-lo[1],hi[2]-lo[2],hi[3]-lo[3])
 if extent~=extent or extent<=.001 or extent==math.huge then return nil end
 return extent
end
local function sizeWeapon(entry,parent)
 if not entry.localExtent then entry.localExtent=measureWeapon(entry.weapon)end
 if not entry.localExtent then return false end
 local reach=entry.rig and entry.rig.reach or .7
 local length=entry.className=="mage"and clamp(reach*2.7,1.5,2.4)or(entry.className=="ranged"and clamp(reach*1.3,.7,1.2)or clamp(reach*1.8,1,1.7))
 local f=length*(entry.ultimateScale or 1)/entry.localExtent;local p=parent.lossyScale
 -- A loading avatar can briefly have collapsed scale. Never compensate it with
 -- a huge local scale which becomes visible when the native rig settles.
 for _,v in ipairs({p.x,p.y,p.z})do
  if v~=v or math.abs(v)<.0001 or math.abs(v)==math.huge then return false end
 end
 entry.weapon.transform.localScale=Vector3(f/math.abs(p.x),f/math.abs(p.y),f/math.abs(p.z))
 return true
end
local function attachToHand(entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.weapon == nil or not isActorAlive(entry.actor) then return false end

  local palmOk, palmPosition, palmRotation = pcall(function()
    return entry.actor:CalculatePalmTransform(entry.className=="ranged")
  end)
  if not palmOk or palmPosition == nil or palmRotation == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("palm-transform", "CalculatePalmTransform failed; weapon cannot be attached")
    return false
  end

  local calibration = entry.calibration
  local calibrationRotation = Quaternion.Euler(calibration.pitch, calibration.yaw, calibration.roll)
  local calibrationMatrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(
    Vector3(-calibration.shift, 0, 0),
    calibrationRotation,
    Vector3.one
  )
  local gripMatrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(entry.gripPosition, entry.gripRotation, Vector3.one)
  local palmMatrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(palmPosition, palmRotation, Vector3.one)
  local palmToWeapon = calibrationMatrix * gripMatrix.inverse

  local hand = entry.rig ~= nil and entry.rig.hand or nil
  if hand ~= nil then
    entry.weapon.transform:SetParent(hand, false)
    if not sizeWeapon(entry,hand)then return false end
    local desired = palmMatrix * calibrationMatrix * gripMatrix.inverse
    entry.weapon.transform.rotation = desired.rotation
    local scaledGrip = entry.weapon.transform:TransformVector(entry.gripPosition)
    entry.weapon.transform.position = vSub(palmPosition, scaledGrip)
    entry.weaponLocalRotation = entry.weapon.transform.localRotation
    entry.mode = "bone"
  else
    local root = actorRoot(entry.actor)
    if root == nil then return false end
    local worldMatrix = palmMatrix * palmToWeapon
    entry.weapon.transform:SetParent(root, false)
    entry.weapon.transform.rotation = worldMatrix.rotation
    if not sizeWeapon(entry,root)then return false end
    entry.weapon.transform.position = vSub(palmPosition,entry.weapon.transform:TransformVector(entry.gripPosition))
    entry.palmToWeapon = palmToWeapon
    entry.weaponLocalRotation = nil
    entry.mode = "palm"
  end

  entry.flashNode = findNode(entry.weapon, entry.definition.flashPath)
  entry.glowNode = findNode(entry.weapon, entry.definition.glowPath)
  setNodeActive(entry.flashNode, false)
  setNodeScale(entry.glowNode, 0.001)
  return true
end

-- 人形骨架可能比脚本 Start 稍晚就绪；持续限频检查，成功后从掌心模式切回手骨绑定。
local function tryBuildRig(entry, now)
  if entry == nil then return false end
  if entry.rig ~= nil then return true end
  -- Avatar loading can take longer than five seconds on an uploaded client.
  if entry.nextRigRetry ~= nil and now < entry.nextRigRetry then return false end

  entry.rigRetryCount = (entry.rigRetryCount or 0) + 1
  entry.nextRigRetry = now + 1.0
  entry.rig = buildRig(entry.actor, entry.className)
  if entry.rig ~= nil and entry.mode == "palm" then
    attachToHand(entry)
  end
  return entry.rig ~= nil
end

local function updatePalmAttachment(entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.weapon == nil or not isActorAlive(entry.actor) then return end
  local palmOk, palmPosition, palmRotation = pcall(function()
    return entry.actor:CalculatePalmTransform(entry.className=="ranged")
  end)
  if not palmOk or palmPosition == nil or palmRotation == nil then return end
  local palmMatrix = Matrix4x4.TRS(palmPosition, palmRotation, Vector3.one)
  local worldMatrix = palmMatrix * entry.palmToWeapon
  entry.weapon.transform.rotation = worldMatrix.rotation
  entry.weapon.transform.position = vSub(palmPosition,entry.weapon.transform:TransformVector(entry.gripPosition))
end

local function removeActorListener(entry)
  if entry == nil or entry.actor == nil or entry.actorLoadedListener == nil then return end
  pcall(function()
    entry.actor.onActorLoaded:RemoveListener(entry.actorLoadedListener)
  end)
  entry.actorLoadedListener = nil
end

local function unequipActorInternal(actor)
  if actor == nil then return false end
  local pending=pendingWeapons[actor]
  if pending then pcall(function()Spawn.destroy(pending.weapon)end);pendingWeapons[actor]=nil end
  local entry = equippedByActor[actor]
  if entry == nil then return true end

  equippedByActor[actor] = nil
  removeActorListener(entry)
  pcall(restorePose,entry)
  pcall(clearAttack,entry)

  if entry.weapon ~= nil then
    local ok, message = pcall(function()
      Spawn.destroy(entry.weapon)
    end)
    if not ok then
      logger:warnOnce("destroy-weapon", "failed to destroy equipped weapon", message)
    end
  end
  return true
end

local resourcesReady=false
local nextResourceAttempt=-1
local resourceStatus="waiting resources"
local function ensureWeaponResources()
 if resourcesReady then return true end
 if Time.time<nextResourceAttempt then return false end
 nextResourceAttempt=Time.time+.5
 -- RuntimeScope is fixed by the saved binding; do not reconstruct it in Update.
 resourceRoot=runtimeScope and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot()or nil
 if not resourceRoot then resourceStatus="scope unavailable";return false end
 local ready=true
 for className,definition in pairs(WEAPON_DEFS)do
  definition.sourceGo=runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(definition.sourcePath)
  local grip=runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(definition.gripPath)
  if definition.sourceGo and grip and completeVisual(definition.sourceGo,className) then
   definition.gripPosition=grip.localPosition;definition.gripRotation=grip.localRotation
  else ready=false;resourceStatus="source/socket missing: "..className end
 end
 hideSourceWeapons()
 if ready then resourcesReady=true;resourceStatus="resources ready"end
 return ready
end

local function equipActorInternal(actor, className)
  if not ensureWeaponResources()then return false end
  if not isActorAlive(actor) then return false end
  if type(className) ~= "string" or not VALID_CLASSES[className] then return false end

  local existing = equippedByActor[actor]
  if existing ~= nil then
    if existing.className == className then
      if liveObject(existing.weapon) and Time.time<(existing.nextHealthCheck or 0) then return true end
      existing.nextHealthCheck=Time.time+.5
      local signature=completeVisual(existing.definition.sourceGo,className)
      local live=completeVisual(existing.weapon,className)
      if live and (not signature or signature==existing.sourceSignature) then
        local rig=buildRig(actor, className)
        if rig and (not existing.rig or existing.rig.hand~=rig.hand) then
          -- The native avatar can replace its placeholder skeleton after Equip.
          pcall(restorePose,existing)
          existing.rig=rig;existing.basePose=nil;existing.rigRetryCount=0
          attachToHand(existing)
        end
        return true
      end
    end
    unequipActorInternal(actor)
  end

  local definition = WEAPON_DEFS[className]
  if definition == nil or definition.sourcePath == nil then return false end
  local signature=completeVisual(definition.sourceGo,className)
  if not signature then resourceStatus="waiting mesh: "..className;return false end
  if definition.gripPosition == nil or definition.gripRotation == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("grip-missing-" .. className, "grip socket is not available for " .. className)
    return false
  end


  local pending=pendingWeapons[actor]
  if pending and (pending.className~=className or pending.sourceSignature~=signature or not liveObject(pending.weapon))then
    pcall(function()Spawn.destroy(pending.weapon)end);pendingWeapons[actor]=nil;pending=nil
  end
  local weapon=pending and pending.weapon or nil
  if not weapon then
    local spawnOk,created=pcall(function()return Spawn.spawn(self,definition.sourcePath,{networked=false})end)
    if not spawnOk or not created then
      logger:warnOnce("spawn-failed-"..className,"failed to spawn weapon source "..className);return false
    end
    weapon=created;weapon:SetActive(false)
    pendingWeapons[actor]={weapon=weapon,className=className,sourceSignature=signature}
  end
  if not completeVisual(weapon,className)then
    resourceStatus="waiting cloned mesh: "..className;return false
  end
  pendingWeapons[actor]=nil
  weapon:SetActive(false)
  enableCopyRenderers(weapon)
  local colliders=weapon:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(UnityEngine.Collider),true)
  for i=0,colliders.Length-1 do colliders[i].enabled=false end

  local entry = {
    actor = actor,
    className = className,
    definition = definition,
    weapon = weapon,
    sourceSignature = signature,
    nextHealthCheck = Time.time+.5,
    gripPosition = definition.gripPosition,
    gripRotation = definition.gripRotation,
    calibration = getCalibration(className),
    rig = buildRig(actor, className),
    mode = "bone",
  }

  equippedByActor[actor] = entry
  if not attachToHand(entry) then
    equippedByActor[actor] = nil
    pcall(function() Spawn.destroy(weapon) end)
    return false
  end

  weapon:SetActive(true)
  do
    entry.actorLoadedListener = function()
      -- 监听器绑定在这名 Actor 上，形象切换后重新建立手骨绑定。
      if not isActorAlive(actor) then return end
      local classNameForReload = className
      unequipActorInternal(actor)
      equipActorInternal(actor, classNameForReload)
    end
    pcall(function()
      actor.onActorLoaded:AddListener(entry.actorLoadedListener)
    end)
  end

  logger:info("equipped", className, "actor=" .. tostring(actor.actorID))
  return true
end

local function faceAttack(actor, root, direction)
 if root==nil or direction==nil then return end
 local horizontal=Vector3(direction.x,0,direction.z)
 if vLength(horizontal)<=.01 then return end
 local rotation=Quaternion.LookRotation(horizontal,Vector3.up)
 actor.rotation=rotation
 root.rotation=rotation
end

local function attackActorInternal(actor, className, attackKind, targetPosition)
  if not isActorAlive(actor) then return false end
  if type(className) ~= "string" or not VALID_CLASSES[className] then return false end

  local resolvedKind = attackKind or DEFAULT_ATTACK_KIND
  if type(resolvedKind) ~= "string" or not VALID_ATTACKS[resolvedKind] then return false end

  if not equipActorInternal(actor, className) then return false end
  local entry = equippedByActor[actor]
  if entry == nil or entry.className ~= className then return false end

  local script = ensureTimelineScript()
  if script == nil or type(script.GetTimeline) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("timeline-missing", "attack timeline helper is not available")
    return false
  end
  local timeline = script.GetTimeline(className, resolvedKind)
  if timeline == nil then
    logger:warnOnce("timeline-" .. className .. "-" .. resolvedKind, "timeline is not defined")
    return false
  end

  local root = actorRoot(actor)
  if root == nil then return false end

  local yawOffset = 0
  local aimWorld = nil
  local facingWorld = nil
  if targetPosition ~= nil and targetPosition.x ~= nil and targetPosition.z ~= nil then
    local delta = vSub(targetPosition, actor.position)
    local horizontal = Vector3(delta.x, 0, delta.z)
    if vLength(horizontal) > 0.01 then
      if resolvedKind~="dash"then
       facingWorld=vNormalize(horizontal)
       faceAttack(actor,root,facingWorld)
      end
      local forwardComponent = vDot(horizontal, root.forward)
      local rightComponent = vDot(horizontal, root.right)
      yawOffset = math.atan(rightComponent, forwardComponent)
    end
    if vLength(delta) > 0.01 then
      aimWorld = vNormalize(delta)
      local aimPitch = math.asin(clamp(aimWorld.y, -1, 1))
      if aimPitch > MAX_AIM_PITCH then
        aimWorld = vNormalize(vLerp(aimWorld, root.forward, 0.5))
      elseif aimPitch < -MAX_AIM_PITCH then
        aimWorld = vNormalize(vLerp(aimWorld, root.forward, 0.5))
      end
    end
  end

  if className == "melee" then
    yawOffset = clamp(yawOffset, -1.35, 1.35)
  end

  local duration = math.max(0.05, timeline.duration / math.max(0.2, AttackSpeed))
  entry.attack = {
    kind = resolvedKind,
    startTime = Time.time,
    duration = duration,
    yawOffset = yawOffset,
    aimWorld = aimWorld,
    facingWorld = facingWorld,
    timeline = timeline,
    sampleScript = script,
  }

  setNodeActive(entry.flashNode, false)
  setNodeScale(entry.glowNode, 0.001)
  return true
end

local function solveArm(rig, target, pole, weight)
  local upper = rig.upper
  local lower = rig.lower
  local hand = rig.hand
  local shoulder = upper.position

  local toTarget = vSub(target, shoulder)
  local distance = vLength(toTarget)
  local minimumReach = math.max(0.02, math.abs(rig.upperLength - rig.lowerLength) + 0.01)
  local maximumReach = (rig.upperLength + rig.lowerLength) * 0.995
  distance = clamp(distance, minimumReach, maximumReach)

  local direction = vNormalize(toTarget)
  local clampedTarget = vAdd(shoulder, vScale(direction, distance))
  local along = (rig.upperLength * rig.upperLength - rig.lowerLength * rig.lowerLength + distance * distance) / (2 * distance)
  local heightSquared = rig.upperLength * rig.upperLength - along * along
  local height = heightSquared > 0 and math.sqrt(heightSquared) or 0

  local perpendicular = vSub(pole, vScale(direction, vDot(pole, direction)))
  if vLength(perpendicular) < 1e-4 then
    perpendicular = vCross(direction, Vector3.up)
    if vLength(perpendicular) < 1e-4 then
      perpendicular = vCross(direction, Vector3.right)
    end
  end

  local elbow = vAdd(vAdd(shoulder, vScale(direction, along)), vScale(vNormalize(perpendicular), height))

  local upperCurrent = upper.rotation
  local lowerCurrentPosition = lower.position
  local upperDelta = Quaternion.FromToRotation(
    vSub(lowerCurrentPosition, shoulder),
    vSub(elbow, shoulder)
  )
  upper.rotation = Quaternion.Slerp(upperCurrent, upperDelta * upperCurrent, weight)

  local lowerCurrent = lower.rotation
  local handCurrentPosition = hand.position
  local lowerToTarget = vSub(clampedTarget, lower.position)
  if vLength(lowerToTarget) > 1e-4 then
    local lowerDelta = Quaternion.FromToRotation(
      vSub(handCurrentPosition, lower.position),
      lowerToTarget
    )
    lower.rotation = Quaternion.Slerp(lowerCurrent, lowerDelta * lowerCurrent, weight)
  end
end

-- Keep the arm in a readable holding pose while native locomotion drives the legs.
-- The DRAGON bow is held in the left hand; the right hand draws to the cheek.
local function applyBowPose(entry,now)
 local rig=entry.rig;local root=actorRoot(entry.actor)
 if not rig or not rig.draw or not root then return end
 local attack=entry.attack;local draw=.12;local weight=.8
 if attack then
  local elapsed=now-attack.startTime
  if elapsed>=attack.duration then clearAttack(entry);attack=nil
  else
   -- Release occurs at 0.33s, shared with the attack hit/effect window.
   draw=elapsed<.33 and math.min(1,elapsed/.3)or math.max(.12,1-(elapsed-.33)/.09)
   weight=1
  end
 end
 local aim=attack and attack.aimWorld or root.forward
 local leftTarget=vAdd(rig.upper.position,vAdd(vScale(aim,rig.reach*.9),vScale(root.up,-rig.reach*.12)))
 solveArm(rig,leftTarget,vScale(root.right,-1),weight)
 if entry.weaponLocalRotation then rig.hand.rotation=Quaternion.LookRotation(aim,root.up)*Quaternion.Inverse(entry.weaponLocalRotation)end
 local nearString=vAdd(rig.hand.position,vScale(root.right,.08))
 local cheek=vAdd(rig.draw.upper.position,vAdd(vScale(root.up,.14),vScale(root.forward,.12)))
 solveArm(rig.draw,vLerp(nearString,cheek,draw),vAdd(root.right,vScale(root.forward,-.4)),weight)
end

local function applyHoldingPose(entry)
 local rig=entry.rig;local root=actorRoot(entry.actor)
 if not rig or not root or not entry.weaponLocalRotation then return end
 local h,aim
 if entry.className=="mage"then h={.18,-.38,.48};aim={.08,.98,.16}
 elseif entry.className=="ranged"then h={-.08,-.18,.73};aim={0,-.08,1}
 else h={.22,-.12,.5};aim={.15,.12,.98}end
 local shoulder=rig.upper.position
 local target=vAdd(shoulder,vAdd(vAdd(vScale(root.right,h[1]*rig.reach),vScale(root.up,h[2]*rig.reach)),vScale(root.forward,h[3]*rig.reach)))
 local pole=vAdd(vScale(root.right,.75),vScale(root.forward,-.3))
 solveArm(rig,target,pole,.85)
 local direction=vNormalize(vAdd(vAdd(vScale(root.right,aim[1]),vScale(root.up,aim[2])),vScale(root.forward,aim[3])))

local function applyAttack(entry, now)
  local attack = entry.attack
  if attack == nil then return end

  local elapsed = now - attack.startTime
  local normalized = elapsed / attack.duration
  if normalized >= 1 then
    clearAttack(entry)
    return
  end

  local sample = attack.sampleScript.Sample(attack.timeline, normalized)
  if sample == nil then
    clearAttack(entry)
    return
  end

  -- 先确保骨架绑定，再刷新特效，避免降级模式切回手骨时把本帧特效重置掉。
  tryBuildRig(entry, now)

  setNodeActive(entry.flashNode, sample.flash == true)
  if sample.flash == true then
    setNodeScale(entry.flashNode, 1)
  end
  if entry.glowNode ~= nil then
    local glowScale = 0.001 + (sample.glow or 0) * 0.999
    entry.glowNode.localScale = Vector3(glowScale, glowScale, glowScale)
  end

  local weight = clamp(sample.weight or 0, 0, 1)
  if weight <= 0.001 then return end

  local root = actorRoot(entry.actor)
  if root == nil then
    clearAttack(entry)
    return
  end

  local rotatedAim = rotateLocalYaw(sample.aim, attack.yawOffset)
  local localAim = vNormalize(vAdd(
    vAdd(vScale(root.right, rotatedAim[1]), vScale(root.up, rotatedAim[2])),
    vScale(root.forward, rotatedAim[3])
  ))
  local aim = localAim
  if attack.aimWorld ~= nil and (sample.targetBlend or 0) > 0.001 then
    aim = vNormalize(vLerp(localAim, attack.aimWorld, sample.targetBlend))
  end

  if entry.rig == nil then
    -- 非人形骨架降级：不伪造手臂动作，只让武器跟随手掌并朝向目标。
    if entry.mode == "palm" then
      updatePalmAttachment(entry)
      local up = Vector3.up
      if math.abs(vDot(aim, up)) > 0.95 then up = root.forward end
      -- Keep the rigid palm attachment when humanoid bones are unavailable.
    end
    return
  end

  local rig = entry.rig
  if rig.spine ~= nil and math.abs(sample.spine) > 0.01 then
    local current = rig.spine.rotation
    local target = Quaternion.AngleAxis(sample.spine * TorsoTwistScale, root.up) * current
    rig.spine.rotation = Quaternion.Slerp(current, target, weight)
  end

  if rig.spine and math.abs(sample.lean or 0)>.01 then
    rig.spine.rotation=Quaternion.AngleAxis((sample.lean or 0)*weight,root.right)*rig.spine.rotation
  end
  local offset = rotateLocalYaw(sample.hand, attack.yawOffset)
  local shoulder = rig.upper.position
  local handTarget = vAdd(
    shoulder,
    vAdd(
      vAdd(vScale(root.right, offset[1] * rig.reach), vScale(root.up, offset[2] * rig.reach)),
      vScale(root.forward, offset[3] * rig.reach)
    )
  )

  local pole = vAdd(
    vAdd(vScale(root.right, 0.7), vScale(root.forward, -0.45)),
    vScale(root.up, 0.15)
  )
  solveArm(rig, handTarget, pole, weight)

  if entry.weaponLocalRotation == nil then return end
  local up = Vector3.up
  if math.abs(vDot(aim, up)) > 0.95 then up = root.forward end
  local targetWeaponRotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(aim, up)
  local desiredHandRotation = targetWeaponRotation * Quaternion.Inverse(entry.weaponLocalRotation)
  local currentHandRotation = rig.hand.rotation
  rig.hand.rotation = Quaternion.Slerp(currentHandRotation, desiredHandRotation, weight)
end

local function handleHostEvent(eventName, payload)
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then return false end

    return equipActorInternal(payload.actor, payload.className)
  elseif eventName == EVENT_ATTACK then
    return attackActorInternal(payload.actor, payload.className, payload.attackKind, payload.targetPosition)
  elseif eventName == EVENT_UNEQUIP then
    return unequipActorInternal(payload.actor)
  end
  return false
end

local function registerWithHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil or resourceEntry~=nil then return end

  if hostScript == nil then
    logger:info("runtime host unavailable; direct script API remains available")
    return
  end
  if type(hostScript.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then

    return

    local existing = hostScript.GetResources({ tag = RIG_TAG })

    tags = { RIG_TAG },

local function clamp01(value)
  if value < 0 then return 0 end
  if value > 1 then return 1 end
  return value
end

local function smoothstep(value)
  local t = clamp01(value)
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

local function lerp(a, b, t)
  return a + (b - a) * t
end

local function lerpVec(a, b, t)
  return {
    lerp(a[1], b[1], t),
    lerp(a[2], b[2], t),
    lerp(a[3], b[3], t),
  }
end

local function normalizeVec(value)
  local x = value[1]
  local y = value[2]
  local z = value[3]
  local length = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)
  if length < 1e-6 then
    return { 0, 0, 1 }
  end
  return { x / length, y / length, z / length }
end

local function effectProgress(effect, t)
  if effect == nil then return 0 end
  local start = effect.start or 0
  local duration = effect.duration or 0
  if duration <= 0 or t < start or t > start + duration then return 0 end
  return clamp01((t - start) / duration)
end

local function buildSample(timeline, t, hand, aim, spine, weight, targetBlend, lean)
  local glowPhase = effectProgress(timeline.glow, t)
  local glow = 0
  if glowPhase > 0 and glowPhase < 1 then
    glow = math.sin(math.pi * glowPhase)
  elseif glowPhase >= 1 then
    glow = 0
  end
  return {
    hand = hand,
    aim = aim,
    spine = spine,
    lean = lean or 0,
    weight = weight,
    targetBlend = targetBlend,
    glow = glow,
    flash = effectProgress(timeline.flash, t) > 0,
  }
end

function Sample(timeline, t)

  if value <= first.t then

  end
  if value >= last.t then

  end

  for index = 1, #keys - 1 do

    local b = keys[index + 1]
    if value >= a.t and value <= b.t then
      local span = math.max(1e-5, b.t - a.t)
      local u = smoothstep((value - a.t) / span)
      return buildSample(
        timeline,
        value,
        lerpVec(a.hand, b.hand, u),
        normalizeVec(lerpVec(a.aim, b.aim, u)),
        lerp(a.spine, b.spine, u),
        lerp(a.weight, b.weight, u),
        lerp(a.target or 0, b.target or 0, u),
        lerp(a.lean or 0,b.lean or 0,u)
      )
    end
  end

  return buildSample(timeline, value, last.hand, normalizeVec(last.aim), last.spine, last.weight, last.target or 0,last.lean or 0)
end
